prompt.title: Prompt
paragraphs: You are helping a {{role}} review weekly business performance.
Prepare a concise weekly performance review that highlights business momentum, one operational risk, and the most important management action.
Keep the update practical for the {{role}} and ready to share with leadership.
checklist: Identify the top three business signals for the {{role}}.
Highlight one operational risk with a short explanation.
Reference the weekly KPI table and management notes.
Keep the summary concise and decision-oriented.
